no-restricted-syntax.message: Do not recover an HTTP status from an error message. ApiError carries it as `err.status` (src/api/client.ts). Its `message` is the response BODY and only falls back to the literal `HTTP <status>` when that body is EMPTY — so a message test silently matches empty-body responses and nothing else. That is #646, and it had already produced #624, #625 and three more latent sites. Read `err.status`.

Do not recover an HTTP status by matching a regex against an error message. ApiError carries it as `err.status` (src/api/client.ts); `message` is the response BODY and only falls back to `HTTP <status>` when that body is EMPTY, so this regex can only ever match empty-body responses. See #646. Read `err.status`.
